headline: Ambika Cotton Mills submits transcript of Chairman's statement at AGM
summary: Ambika Cotton Mills has submitted the official transcript of the Chairman's statement from its 38th Annual General Meeting to the stock exchanges. This is a routine compliance filing required by regulatory norms for listed entities. The filing provides the company's official record of the proceedings and management commentary shared during the AGM. Indian retail investors tracking the company can review the transcript for operational updates.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing containing no immediate financial trigger for retail holders

headline: Ambika Cotton Mills corrects voting report typo for 38th AGM
hook: Typo fixed in annual meeting filing
summary: Ambika Cotton Mills Limited has submitted a corrected Scrutinizer's Report to the exchange following a typographical error regarding the month of its 38th Annual General Meeting. The revised report was dated September 30, 2026. This administrative correction has no material impact on the company's financial performance or business operations. Indian retail investors hold no direct consequence from this routine procedural filing.
why_it_matters: Zero impact on share price or operations.
